description: ISSUE-202, ADR-013 items 2-3 and 8, 15 §4.4: a launch with both delegation gates on (the request carries a ticket-file DelegationInjection; row X1 mcpInjection ticket-file, SP-12 partial). The Jev entry travels only in codex's argv as -c overrides: the relay command, its args, and its own env holding ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE and the credential file PATH (the relay form of 15 §4), then approval_mode approve scoped to exactly delegate_subtask and subtask_result inside that entry (ADR-008 item 3's named exception, C-24). No credential value and no DWARFAI_DELEGATION_TOKEN string is in any argv, env or frame (C-23, INV-59, INV-83); thread/start carries no MCP configuration (the entry never goes through the protocol while SP-12 is partial). The provider side is the c-20 first turn (the recorded Codex 0.153.4 shapes): Codex's answers do not depend on the -c overrides. `argv` is the spawned argv without the executable.
